summaries.summary: The provided chunk implements VS Code hover/documentation support for CSM-related files, including static help text for operators, commands, log events, and user-defined anchors. It only imports the vscode API and performs local text parsing, regex matching, and hover construction. There are no network calls, filesystem access, child_process usage, eval/Function execution, credential harvesting, clipboard access, obfuscation, persistence, or remote content loading. The advertised functionality, activation events, package size, and observed code behavior are proportional. The only minor note is that some hover MarkdownString instances are marked trusted, but HTML is disabled and the content is static, so this does not indicate malicious behavior. Confidence is slightly reduced because only chunk 1/2 was provided, but no suspicious indicators are present in the analyzed code.
